description: No configuration management policy and procedures have been documented or implemented to govern the development, documentation, and dissemination of configuration management practices.
applicability: This signal applies to: Cloud Service Providers (CSPs) seeking FedRAMP authorization Federal agencies operating cloud systems Third Party Assessment Organizations (3PAOs) conducting assessments Federal information systems processing government data

metadata.detection_notes: Detection guidance: Review system documentation repositories, policy management systems, and governance frameworks to determine if formal configuration management policies and procedures exist. Check for documented approval workflows, version control of policies, and evidence of dissemination to relevant personnel. Look for absence of policy documents, outdated policies, or lack of defined procedures for configuration management activities.

sources.title: FISMA - Federal Information Security Modernization Act
